Sheetal Devi Secures Multiple Medals at 2026 Asian Para Games

A Defining Performance in Japan

Indian para-archer Sheetal Devi has continued her rise in international competition, securing two gold medals and a silver at the 2026 Asian Para Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Devi, who competes in the compound archery category, successfully defended her women's individual title and secured a top podium finish in the mixed team event alongside teammate Toman Kumar. Additionally, she earned a silver medal in the women's doubles competition with partner Payal Nag.

Overcoming Physical Challenges Through Adaptation

Born in 2007 in the Kishtwar district of Jammu and Kashmir, Devi was born without arms. She developed the physical foundation for her sport by performing daily tasks with her feet, which helped foster the exceptional balance and strength required for her unique archery technique.

Her process involves several distinct mechanical adaptations:

  • Stance: Utilizing her foot to steady the bow.
  • Draw: Engaging her shoulder muscles to draw the bowstring.
  • Release: Employing a specialized release aid held in her mouth to execute the shot.

This method was developed in collaboration with her coach, Kuldeep Vedwan, and the training staff at the Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine Board Sports Complex, following her identification as a prospect at an Indian Army camp in 2019. Initial training focused heavily on core stability and strength, allowing her to eventually compete at the standard 50-meter distance.

Building a Career of Consistency

Devi's recent success in Japan builds upon a series of significant career milestones:

  • 2023 Asian Para Games: Won gold in individual and mixed team events, with a silver in women’s doubles.
  • 2024 Paris Paralympic Games: Became India's youngest Paralympic medalist at age 17, winning bronze in the mixed team compound event.
  • 2025 World Archery Para Championships: Captured the individual world title in Gwangju, South Korea.

In statements regarding her training, Devi has emphasized a focus on process and consistency over external pressure. Beyond her medals, she has stated her intent to encourage others with disabilities to pursue their capabilities and has highlighted the importance of parental support in fostering athletic development.

Verifying Results

Official results and match summaries from the 2026 Asian Para Games can be verified through the Asian Paralympic Committee or the official tournament organizing committee websites. Readers can follow her career developments and training updates through her verified social media presence on Instagram under the handle @sheetal_archery.
